title: Figure 3. Air Traffic Control: Potomac TRACON facility, ATC station, and radar display
description: Three photographs: (a) an overview of the large Potomac TRACON facility with rows of controller consoles under a circular ceiling; (b) a controller seated at a single ATC TRACON station beside a radar display; (c) a close-up of a green-on-black Minneapolis-St. Paul TRACON radar display showing aircraft data blocks with designations, altitude, and airspeed. Captioned "Figure 3. Air Traffic Control."
